Move the crosshair. The ship turns toward it and the mini gun fires AT it.
W / A / S / D
W and S throttle up and down; below zero it reverses. A and D slide left and right without turning, at 4.5 units a second.
R / C
Slide up and down without turning, at 4.5 units a second.
Q / E
Roll left and right.
SHIFT / TAB
Boost. SHIFT is 1x, 19 units a second against a cruise of 8. TAB is 2x, 38 a second, burning fuel 2x as fast. Both ignore the throttle.
X
Full stop.
LEFT CLICK / SPACE
Primary weapon. Only the left button fires.
RIGHT CLICK
Secondary weapon. Press again to detonate a torpedo.
1 to 6
Pick the primary along the upgrade line: 1 pulse, 2 mini gun (aims at the crosshair), 3 to 6 the beams.
F (HOLD)
SHIELD. Absorbs 80% of a hit. Ten charges, one every half second held.
V
Cockpit or third person. OPTION + WHEEL sets the distance.
ARROWS
Steer, for anyone who would rather not use the mouse.
ESC
Back to the map.
7
Rear Gun, when you hold one: a rear view top right. Aim in it to fire backwards; right-click there for a torpedo.
Y
Use a held Instant Recharge; a Supercharge when you are already full (up to double).
I
Inventory: your ships, guns, sealed spheres and items. Right-click a sphere to open it.
